verdict.rationale: Penpot's evidence documents self-hosting: you can choose where data is hosted and who can access it. That is a hosting and access control, not a documented feature for setting retention periods or deleting user or AI-processed data. No retention policy, data-deletion, or purge capability is shown, so this related deployment control earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
